pocs.description:
1. Python-based script generated in PyCharm for the identification of pageload extensions across 80+ websites and 20000+ domain URLs
2. JavaScript-based script generated in Tealium iQ for the identification of custom extensions without targeting conditions (c3:1) across 11 profiles and 6000+ tags

pocs.title: Accelerating Large-Scale Tealium iQ Extension Code Reviews (6000+ Tags)
pocs.description:
Created a custom-based extraction and validation approach that runs directly from the browser console within the Tealium iQ interface. The script programmatically reads extension configurations and compiles the information into a structured custom requirement dataset.
The extracted output includes various key extension details such as:
• Extension Name and Type
• Scope and Load Rule
• Cookie Consent condition manual added to Extension Codes
• Set Data Values & Lookup Table configuration
• Trigger conditions applied within the extension
• List out custom Code Snippets used inside extensions
This structured output allows engineers to quickly analyze the entire extension ecosystem without manually navigating through each configuration.
